name: Dash the Golden-Spotted Cat
blurb: Dash, a lean, long-legged golden shorthair with round black spots and dark tear-lines under honey-gold eyes, sprints the lawn end to end, then naps.

name: Ponder the Tawny Spotted Cat
blurb: Ponder, a tawny spotted cat with a cream belly and a black-ringed, white-tipped tail, sits on the sundial for hours guessing where the next moth lands.

name: Tally the Sand-Spotted Cat
blurb: Tally, a sandy-gold cat dotted with small black spots, dark tear-marks and small round ears, counts the pond's goldfish each morning and never misses one.
